Основная причина возникновения теменного: The main cause of the dark circle is total internal reflection at the lower boundary of the plate. When the ray falls on the paper, light scatters in all directions, so rays arise inside the plate going in all directions. If the angle of incidence on this boundary is less than the critical angle of total internal reflection, most of the light exits the plate; at a larger angle, all the light is reflected and forms a bright halo around the dark spot.
